name: Laura Olhasso
office: Foothill Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 4

items.text: Laura Olhasso was appointed to the Foothill Municipal Water District Board of Directors, Division 4, in February 2026. She is a former mayor and city councilmember of La Cañada Flintridge. She previously served on the LA County Sanitation District board and as president of the California Contract Cities Association.
